findings.finding: The plan makes the operation snapshot (OperationSnapshot / compose_operation_snapshot) the primary cut target, but the codebase-aligned composition seam for the bulk of these reads is the config.py / _config_sources.py resolvers threaded through the pass — the basenames the gate recognizes as COMPOSITION_ROOT_BASENAMES and the mechanism the sibling slices use ('CUT to an owned config.py / _config_sources.py resolver threaded through the pass'). By leading with the snapshot the plan under-specifies which seam an ambient env/load_config read below the reconciler should be threaded from, risking an implementer routing reads through a snapshot that does not carry them.
scenarios: An env-read (e.g. REBAR_ROOT precedence, REBAR_ENV_ID identity) that belongs in a config.py resolver is instead forced onto OperationSnapshot fields that do not model it
